customManagers.description: Last-reviewed upstream fork commit. A bump PR means upstream moved: review it (see MAINTAINING.md).

packageRules.description: FastNoiseLite changes the compiled wheel and can change the noise LedFx effects render; the golden-value tests show whether it did. A person reads these, as with upstream bumps that need porting.
Git commits carry no release timestamp; the preset's release-age wait would hold these forever.
